helpScreen.intro: Find answers to common questions or reach our support team for personalized help.

bidding.question: How do I place a bid?
bidding.answer: Browse live auctions on the dashboard, open an auction detail page, and tap Place Bid. Enter your amount and confirm. You'll receive alerts if you're outbid.

kyc.question: Why is KYC verification required?
kyc.answer: Identity verification protects all participants and ensures only verified users can bid on high-value assets. Submit your documents from your profile.

payments.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payments.answer: Enderas supports bank transfer, mobile money, and major cards. Payment details are shared after you win an auction.

assets.question: How do I list an asset for auction?
assets.answer: Go to My Assets, tap Submit Asset, and fill in the details with photos. Our team reviews submissions before listing.
